articles.summary: Omeros Corporation (NASDAQ: OMER) today announced that it will issue its financial results for the third quarter of 2026 on Monday, November 16, 2026 after market close. Omeros management will host a conference call and webcast that same day at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time (1:30 p.m. Pacific Time) to discuss recent developments and highlights as well as the Company’s financial results. Conference Call Details and Webcast Link Instructions To access the live webcast, please click here or visit the “ Upcoming Events ” section of the Investor Relations page of Omeros’ website. A replay of the call will be available for 90 days in the “ Archived Events ” section of the Investor Relations page of Omeros’ website. As Omeros continues to transition to a new earnings call platform (hosted by Q4 Inc.), please allow extra time to log in prior to the start of the call. articles.summary: – Conference Call Today at 4:30 p.m. ET Omeros Corporation (Nasdaq: OMER) today announced recent highlights and developments as well as financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, which include: Third Quarter and Recent Highlights YARTEMLEA ® (narsoplimab-wuug), the first and only approved treatment for stem cell transplant-associated thrombotic microangiopathy (“TA-TMA”), an often-lethal complication of stem cell transplantation, generated gross revenue of $41.8 million in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 30% from $32.2 million in the second quarter. Net revenue increased 26% to $35.9 million from $28.5 million in the second quarter. The third-quarter gross-to-net adjustment was 14.0% compared to 11.5% in the prior quarter.
